priority: Only after custom MediPFN v2 stages; no competition for its allocation

route_a.name: frozen TabPFN-v3 nuisance backbone plus mediation NIE error head
route_a.relation: TabCon-backbone-style adaptation; not original TabCon, no RL claim
requires: valid licensed local v3 classifier/regressor weights
route_a.fallback: Existing frozen TabPFN-v2 can be evaluated under its explicit name; it must not be labeled v3 or original TabCon

route_b.name: TabPFN-v2 offline cross-task mediation fine-tuning
route_b.training_inputs: Independent DGP tables through get_preprocessed_datasets lists; meta_batch_size=1; gradient accumulation across tables
route_b.selection: Independent same-source DEV only; OOD and calibration labels prohibited
route_b.deployment: Freeze updated weights globally; in-context fit only, no per-test SGD
mandatory_before_submission: actual installed classifier and regressor gradients nonzero
parameter identity retained across independent tables

shared.nuisance_score: Bayes density ratio from pi(X),g(X,M),mu1(X,M), nested eta0(X), direct eta1(X)
shared.uncertainty: Learn standardized estimator error on independent synthetic train tasks; new DEV post-training and fresh calibration after backbone freezing

route_c.name: TabPFN-v3 frozen backbone plus cross-task mediation input/output adapter
route_c.context_policy: Separate task context and fresh preprocessing for each independent table; shared frozen V3 weights by ModelSpecs
route_c.selection: Fixed sixteen independent DEV contexts, two per training source family; best.pt and last.pt
